title: ReviewItem
description: A 'still need this?' decision recorded by a human. Muretto never acts on it.

resource_id.description: Stable Muretto resource id: <kind>:<provider_id>. Deterministic, so two machines that see the same resource produce the same id.

owner_developer_id.description: The developer whose session created it; null when the creator is unknown.

decided_by.description: Local developer id: a hash of the machine id, or the linked account id once logged in.
